tasks.short: Prepare and launch online auctions for selected stock.

steps.what: Check stock availability, condition and acquisition cost.
Enter product details, images and delivery terms into an auction platform.
Set reserve price, auction duration and launch time.
Review the auction preview and approve publication.
Publish the approved auction and record its listing reference.

tasks.design: An integration reads eligible stock from the {OPS_SYSTEM} and costs from the {ERP}; configured templates create auction drafts in the {OTHER} auction platform. The merchant chooses commercial terms and approves a specific preview, after which a deterministic flow publishes it and stores the listing reference in the {OPS_SYSTEM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock, images and auction fields sit in different places. Platform-specific field mapping and reliable publication handling take work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing bulk-listing features can supply the templates. AI-assisted coding can shorten adapter development without changing the need for stock checks and publication tests.
tasks.still_hard: Condition descriptions, unusual collectibles and reserve prices need judgement. Stock reservations and failed publication retries must prevent duplicate sales.
tasks.human_edge: The merchant judges buyer appeal, condition uncertainty and the price worth accepting.

ambition.what: Weekly reserve-price revisions for ageing stock

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from field entry to auction economics and stock exceptions. Within a delegated pricing band, the merchant can revise reserves weekly; publication authority remains subject to the approved limits.

reach.task: Improve listing titles for buyer search intent.
reach.learn: Search query analysis and the auction platform's title constraints.

evidence.claim: Structured product fields, templates and approved publication flows usually need deterministic automation.
Shopify Sidekick generates product descriptions; this supports optional copy assistance, not auction publication.

assumptions: Auctions are a supplemental sales channel, often used for surplus or unusual stock.
The auction platform supports draft templates and an authorised publication interface.
Approved product facts are sufficient for template-based descriptions; no model loop is needed.
The structured-work prior fits field entry, but commercial decisions retain human time.
Time shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates.
The access range covers account permissions and a GDPR review of any customer-data transfer.
unknowns: Which auction channels are used and what draft, scheduling and publication interfaces they expose.
Whether stock can be reserved across sales channels.
Who may approve reserves, delivery terms and publication.
Whether product condition and images are already reliable.
research_questions: Which publication interfaces support duplicate prevention and recovery after uncertain responses?
Can configured listing templates cover the required item categories without custom generation?
new_work: Review generated previews and stock exceptions.
Maintain field mappings, templates and delivery terms.
Resolve failed launches and reconcile listing references.
Check that published terms match the approved preview.

tasks.short: Coordinate and verify security controls for online retail operations and customer data.

steps.what: Document customer-data flows, critical services and current security controls.
Assess gaps using a security-management system and service configuration evidence.
Approve security changes, privacy implications and acceptable service disruption.
Configure encryption, access, redundancy and firewall controls in infrastructure-management tools.
Check monitoring and recovery-test evidence, then accept controls or request fixes.

tasks.design: Read-only connectors assemble service scope and configuration evidence from the {ECOMMERCE} and the {OTHER} infrastructure and security tools into the {DOCS}. Existing control templates apply approved changes through the {OTHER} infrastructure tools, while deterministic checks feed a {BI} dashboard for security acceptance and merchant follow-up.
tasks.previous_blocker: Service ownership, configuration evidence and business impact were fragmented. Automation also needed privileged access and tested recovery paths.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing infrastructure controls and configuration checks provide reusable foundations. AI-assisted coding can reduce the effort of connecting evidence and generating review packs.
tasks.still_hard: Threat modelling, residual risk and recovery under real failure remain specialist work. Legacy services may resist standard controls.
tasks.human_edge: The merchant explains customer and trading impact; security and IT specialists decide technical risk and safe deployment.

ambition.what: Weekly prioritisation of customer-data exposure fixes

tasks.altitude: The merchant spends less time collecting evidence and more time setting business priorities with security specialists. Technical approval rights do not change; delegated trading decisions can use fresher risk evidence.

reach.task: Design secure account and checkout flows.
reach.learn: Authentication failure states, data minimisation and usable recovery flows.

evidence.claim: Configuration baselines, access controls, monitoring and recovery tests can automate evidence gathering and routine control deployment.
GDPR security obligations apply to customer-data processing; required measures depend on processing risks.
National rules may require employee consultation when security changes introduce staff monitoring.

assumptions: In a mid-size company, the merchant coordinates retail requirements while security and IT teams implement controls.
Existing managed controls cover routine encryption, access, redundancy and firewall configuration.
The judgement-heavy prior fits risk assessment; evidence collection offers clearer savings.
Time shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates for an initial control scope.
The access range includes privileged-access review and employee consultation under national rules where applicable.
GDPR applies; any later model feature also needs an EU AI Act applicability assessment.
unknowns: Which services the company controls directly and which are managed externally.
Current control gaps, recovery objectives and security ownership.
Whether proposed monitoring processes employee data.
Applicable national consultation requirements and representative bodies.
Availability of configuration interfaces, test environments and rollback procedures.
research_questions: Which native controls expose reliable configuration and recovery evidence?
Which checks can verify effective controls rather than merely confirm settings?
new_work: Review evidence gaps and failed control checks.
Maintain service ownership and approved configuration baselines.
Test rollback and recovery after material changes.
Review privileged connector access and retention of security evidence.

tasks.short: Find and assess merchandise sources for commercial potential, condition and reliability.

steps.what: Search supplier portals and auction catalogues for relevant lots.
Read catalogues and supplier messages, recording terms, condition and provenance claims.

loop.input: Selected supplier catalogues and messages, with a fixed comparison schema.
loop.output: Source comparison with cited terms, condition claims, provenance claims and missing fields.
loop.check: Validate field types and currencies; require source excerpts; mark claims as unverified.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per document; unreadable or conflicting material goes to the merchant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Catalogues and messages describe condition and terms in inconsistent free text.

steps.what: Calculate landed cost and compare likely resale margins.
Inspect goods and question sellers at trade shows, sales or supplier visits.
Select promising sources and record reasons for further buying discussions.

tasks.design: Permitted feeds from the {PARTNER_PORTAL} and the {OTHER} auction catalogue sites populate a source register in the {WORKFLOW}. A bounded extractor reads selected material from the {DOCS} and {EMAIL}, while deterministic calculations combine costs from the {ERP} with merchant assumptions in a {BI} comparison; inspections and source selection remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source information mixes structured listings, documents and conversations. Condition and provenance cannot be reduced to a common price field.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded extraction can turn varied documents into cited comparison fields. Faster adapter development makes a shared source register more practical.
tasks.still_hard: Authenticity, hidden defects, supplier trust and uncertain resale demand need direct assessment. Many valuable sources have no usable feed.
tasks.human_edge: The merchant notices physical quality, tests seller credibility and recognises merchandise buyers may value.
tasks.altitude: The week shifts towards inspections and commercial assessment, with less catalogue transcription. The merchant can recommend small trial purchases more quickly; purchase approval limits stay with the buying manager.

reach.task: Test demand for a proposed merchandise category.
reach.learn: Demand sampling, competitor comparisons and uncertainty in resale estimates.

reach.task: Assess evidence behind supplier environmental claims.
reach.learn: Traceability evidence and the limits of supplier declarations.

evidence.claim: Fixed-schema extraction with source excerpts can reduce transcription from varied supplier documents.
EU TARIC supplies duty rates and measures for landed-cost calculations where classification and origin are known.
Physical condition, provenance and supplier reliability require evidence beyond extracted catalogue claims.

assumptions: The merchant investigates both online sources and occasional physical events.
Collection is limited to authorised feeds, permitted pages and supplied documents.
The unstructured and situational priors fit the work; supplier inspection retains substantial time.
Duty calculations use confirmed classifications; disputed classification is referred to a specialist.
Time shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates.
Access work includes GDPR handling of supplier contact details and an EU AI Act applicability check for the extractor.
unknowns: Which merchandise categories and sourcing channels matter.
Availability and permission status of catalogue feeds.
Required provenance, authenticity and product-safety evidence.
Who sets resale assumptions and approves trial purchases.
Whether import classification, freight and tax inputs are reliable.
research_questions: How reliably can the extractor distinguish verified facts from supplier claims across catalogue formats?
Which source feeds provide stable lot identifiers and change notices?
new_work: Review extracted claims, missing terms and currency exceptions.
Maintain source permissions, adapters and comparison fields.
Update freight, duty and margin assumptions.
Attach inspection evidence and record why sources were rejected.

tasks.short: Learn from retail forums and conferences, then identify useful changes and security concerns.

steps.what: Choose relevant forums, conference sessions and subscriptions.
Read forum threads, newsletters and conference materials.

loop.input: A bounded batch of permitted forum posts, newsletters and conference materials.
loop.output: A short brief with source links, dated claims, disagreements and open questions.
loop.check: Require a source excerpt for each factual claim; check dates and flag unsupported security advice.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair per batch of up to twenty items; failed checks leave source-only notes.
loop.why_not_simpler: Useful techniques and caveats are expressed in free text across different sources.

steps.what: Attend conference discussions and ask peers about practical experience.
Select a retail experiment and record its hypothesis, owner and success measure.
Forward credible security concerns with supporting sources to the security team.

tasks.design: Configured subscriptions collect permitted material from the {OTHER} forum and conference platforms and the {EMAIL} into the {DOCS}. A bounded loop drafts a cited brief, and the merchant uses it to prepare peer discussions and proposals in the {PROJECT}; a configured flow forwards merchant-approved security concerns through the {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant information is scattered and mixed with promotion or anecdote. Summaries often lose the evidence needed to judge practical relevance.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked summarisation can reduce initial reading time. Existing subscriptions and simple collection flows provide most of the infrastructure.
tasks.still_hard: Peer credibility, applicability and weak signals need judgement. Private forums and conference material may restrict collection or reuse.
tasks.human_edge: The merchant asks useful questions, interprets lived experience and decides which ideas deserve a controlled trial.
tasks.altitude: The week contains more focused reading and better prepared peer conversations. The merchant can propose and, within delegated limits, lead small experiments; security changes still require specialist approval.

reach.task: Prioritise and evaluate retail marketing experiments.
reach.learn: Hypothesis design, baseline measures and stopping criteria.

reach.task: Turn validated learning into a usable retail procedure.
reach.learn: Evidence-based instructions, audience needs and document versioning.

evidence.claim: Configured subscriptions and bounded summaries can reduce discovery and initial reading work.
A documented Deloitte report contained non-existent sources and led to a partial refund, supporting explicit citation checks.

assumptions: Participation includes substantive conference or peer discussions, so the weak mail-share prior is not adopted literally.
Only permitted source material is collected; private discussions are not recorded by default.
Briefs support learning and do not automatically change retail or security settings.
Time shares, remaining time and build ranges are planning estimates.
Access work covers source permissions, GDPR handling of participant data and EU AI Act applicability for the summariser.
unknowns: Which forums, subscriptions and conferences the merchant actually uses.
Whether their terms permit collection and summarisation.
The actual balance of reading, written participation and live discussions.
Who can authorise experiments and receive security concerns.
research_questions: Which collection methods preserve dates, authorship and stable source references?
How accurately can brief validation catch unsupported claims and stale security advice?
new_work: Review briefs and read the underlying sources for consequential claims.
Maintain source permissions, relevance filters and collection limits.
Track experiment outcomes and route security concerns without treating summaries as verified advice.

role.altitude: The online merchant spends more time on merchandise judgement, pricing and focused experiments, with less transcription and evidence collection. They gain faster recommendations and potentially delegated trial decisions; buying, publication and technical security rights depend on explicit limits.
reach: Search Marketing Strategist: improve auction discoverability using buyer query evidence.
Market Research Analyst: test demand and uncertainty before trial purchases.
Sustainability Specialist: examine provenance and supplier claims.
Web and Digital Interface Designer: connect secure retail operations with usable customer flows.
Marketing Manager: design and evaluate retail experiments.
role.ambitious_version: Run a retail opportunity programme that links sourcing evidence, auction economics and small experiments. Bring buying and marketing managers tested recommendations while security specialists retain technical control.
